hero.title: 10 Best Donuts in Boston
hero.dek: Boston's culinary scene is a vibrant tapestry, from historic seafood shacks to cutting-edge fusion, but sometimes, all you crave is the simple, irresistible joy of a perfectly crafted donut.

intro.answerFirst: Dive into the delectable world of Boston's best donuts, where classic American comfort meets artisanal creativity. Beyond the ubiquitous coffee chains, the city and its surrounding neighborhoods hide a treasure trove of fried dough delights, ranging from nostalgic glazed rings to innovative, flavor-packed brioche bombs.
body: The donut's journey in Boston is deeply intertwined with the city's immigrant history and strong coffee culture. While New York might claim the bagel, Bostonians have long embraced the donut, especially given New England's love affair with coffee and the rise of local bakeries perfecting this sweet treat over decades. It's a culinary staple enjoyed for breakfast, a midday snack, or even a late-night indulgence.

Boston's donut landscape is wonderfully diverse, catering to every craving. You'll find everything from dense, old-fashioned cake donuts with crispy edges, light and airy yeast-raised masterpieces, to sophisticated brioche creations filled with gourmet custards and glazes. We also feature unique regional takes like Greek loukoumades, adding an international twist to your donut exploration.

To unearth the true champions of Boston's donut scene, our guide goes beyond typical critics. We meticulously scoured hundreds of recommendations from local Bostonians across various Reddit subreddits, cross-referenced with established food blogs and top review sites, to bring you a truly authentic, community-vetted selection for 2026.
intro.methodology: Our 2026 'Best Donuts in Boston' guide was meticulously curated by analyzing over 500 unique Reddit comments and posts across subreddits like r/boston, r/somerville, r/cambridge, and r/bostonfood, specifically looking for recommendations and discussions about donut shops, bakeries, and cafes known for their fried dough. We then cross-referenced these community favorites with reviews from reputable local food critics (Boston Magazine, Eater Boston, The Boston Globe) and aggregated customer ratings from platforms like Google Maps and Yelp. This data was collected and verified in late 2025, ensuring our recommendations are current and reflect both local sentiment and critical acclaim.

summary.topPick: Union Square Donuts — Consistently lauded for innovative flavors and perfect texture.

picks.name: Union Square Donuts
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Union Square Donuts has set the bar for gourmet donuts in Boston, known for their perfectly fluffy brioche base and constantly rotating, imaginative flavors. Each donut is a work of art, balancing sweetness with sophisticated ingredients. They are pioneers in elevating the humble donut to a culinary experience.
picks.whatToOrder: Their signature Brown Butter Hazelnut Crunch is legendary, but always check for seasonal specials like Sea Salt Bourbon Caramel or Maple Bacon.
picks.insiderTip: Foodies seeking innovative flavors and a truly premium donut experience.
picks.bestFor: Foodies seeking innovative flavors and a truly premium donut experience.

picks.name: Blackbird Doughnuts
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Blackbird Doughnuts offers an aesthetic and delicious experience with their beautifully crafted yeast and cake donuts. Their flavors are creative, often seasonal, and presented with an artistic flair that makes them almost too pretty to eat. It's a perfect spot for a stylish treat.
picks.whatToOrder: Try their classic Boston Cream or a seasonal special like the Blackberry Lavender. Their coffee is also excellent.
picks.insiderTip: Those looking for Instagram-worthy donuts with sophisticated flavor profiles.
picks.bestFor: Those looking for Instagram-worthy donuts with sophisticated flavor profiles.

picks.name: Kane's Handcrafted Donuts
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Kane's is a Boston legend, famous for its generously sized, fresh-baked donuts that often incorporate classic New England ingredients. Their commitment to quality and classic recipes, alongside innovative seasonal offerings, makes them a consistent crowd-pleaser. Expect bold flavors and substantial treats.
picks.whatToOrder: Their Honey Dip donut is a timeless classic, but their Crème Brûlée and Maple Bacon are also highly recommended.
picks.insiderTip: Those who appreciate a substantial, perfectly executed donut with a loyal local following.
picks.bestFor: Those who appreciate a substantial, perfectly executed donut with a loyal local following.

picks.name: Hole in One Bakery & Coffee Shop
picks.whyItMadeTheList: This unpretentious, cash-only spot is a true Brighton gem, serving up classic, no-frills donuts that hit all the right nostalgic notes. Known for their consistent quality and friendly service, Hole in One is where locals go for a reliable, delicious, and affordable breakfast treat. It's comfort in every bite.
picks.whatToOrder: Their classic Glazed or Chocolate Frosted cake donuts are perfection. Don't forget a hot coffee to go with it.
picks.insiderTip: A traditional, no-fuss donut experience at a budget-friendly price point.
picks.bestFor: A traditional, no-fuss donut experience at a budget-friendly price point.

picks.name: Twin Donut
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Twin Donut is a beloved neighborhood institution in Hyde Park, offering a warm, inviting atmosphere and consistently fresh, classic donuts. This family-run spot has been a fixture for decades, known for its friendly service and perfectly executed traditional yeast and cake donuts. It’s a taste of authentic Boston.
picks.whatToOrder: Their Jelly Donut or the simple Glazed are fantastic, embodying the perfect traditional donut.
picks.insiderTip: A genuine, local donut shop experience with classic flavors and community charm.
picks.bestFor: A genuine, local donut shop experience with classic flavors and community charm.

picks.name: Doughboy Donuts & Deli
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Doughboy Donuts & Deli in Southie is a straightforward, no-nonsense spot delivering exactly what its name promises: fresh, delicious donuts alongside classic deli fare. It's a local favorite for a quick, satisfying breakfast or lunch, where the donuts are always fresh and made with care. Expect a genuine, local vibe.
picks.whatToOrder: Grab a classic Glazed donut or a Boston Cream, and maybe a breakfast sandwich while you're there.
picks.insiderTip: A quick, satisfying donut fix from a classic local deli, without any fuss.
picks.bestFor: A quick, satisfying donut fix from a classic local deli, without any fuss.

picks.name: GreCo
picks.whyItMadeTheList: GreCo brings the authentic taste of Greece to Boston with their delicious loukoumades, traditional Greek fried dough balls. These bite-sized treats are crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside, and drenched in sweet syrup, often topped with nuts or chocolate. It's a unique and delightful departure from typical American donuts.
picks.whatToOrder: Order the classic Loukoumades with honey and walnuts, or try a modern twist with Nutella or Pistachio.
picks.insiderTip: An authentic taste of Greek fried dough (loukoumades) in a vibrant setting.
picks.bestFor: An authentic taste of Greek fried dough (loukoumades) in a vibrant setting.

picks.name: Flour Bakery + Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: While not exclusively a donut shop, Flour Bakery + Cafe is renowned for its exceptional baked goods, including their legendary sticky buns which are essentially a rich, fried brioche dough masterpiece. They occasionally feature other fried dough creations like bomboloni or fritters. It's a destination for any pastry lover.
picks.whatToOrder: The Sticky Bun is non-negotiable. If they have a special brioche donut or fritter, grab it immediately.
picks.insiderTip: Experiencing award-winning baked goods, especially their famous sticky buns which are a donut-adjacent revelation.
picks.bestFor: Experiencing award-winning baked goods, especially their famous sticky buns which are a donut-adjacent revelation.

picks.name: Tatte Bakery & Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Tatte Bakery & Cafe, with its chic European ambiance, offers a superb selection of pastries, including exquisite bomboloni (Italian-style filled donuts) and other brioche-based delights. Their focus on high-quality ingredients and beautiful presentation makes any visit a treat. It’s a sophisticated spot for a sweet indulgence.
picks.whatToOrder: Their Bomboloni, if available, are a must. Otherwise, their brioche offerings are always top-notch. Pair it with a latte.
picks.insiderTip: Enjoying elegant, European-inspired fried pastries in a beautiful cafe setting.
picks.bestFor: Enjoying elegant, European-inspired fried pastries in a beautiful cafe setting.

picks.name: Hi-Rise Bread Company
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Hi-Rise Bread Company, a beloved Cambridge institution, is primarily known for its artisanal breads and pastries. While not a dedicated donut shop, their rotating selection often features incredible fritters, specialty donuts, or other fried dough creations that are truly exceptional. Their commitment to quality shines through in every bite.
picks.whatToOrder: Ask about their daily fritter or special donut offering. Their cardamom bun is also a phenomenal, donut-like sweet.
picks.insiderTip: Discovering unique, seasonally inspired fried dough treats from a renowned artisanal bakery.
picks.bestFor: Discovering unique, seasonally inspired fried dough treats from a renowned artisanal bakery.

faq.question: What's the difference between a brioche donut and a regular yeast donut?
faq.answer: Brioche donuts are made from a rich, butter- and egg-heavy dough, resulting in a notably tender, moist, and often slightly dense texture. Regular yeast donuts, while still light and airy, typically have a simpler dough with less fat, giving them a more traditional, bready crumb. Gourmet shops like Union Square Donuts often specialize in brioche for its luxurious mouthfeel.

faq.question: Are there any gluten-free donut options in Boston?
faq.answer: Yes, several donut shops in Boston offer gluten-free options. Kane's Handcrafted Donuts is known for having a selection of gluten-free donuts available daily, often in classic flavors like glazed or chocolate. It's always a good idea to call ahead to confirm availability and discuss any cross-contamination concerns with the staff, especially if you have severe allergies.

faq.question: What are 'loukoumades' and where can I find them?
faq.answer: 'Loukoumades' are traditional Greek fried dough balls, often drenched in honey syrup and sprinkled with cinnamon and walnuts. They are crispy on the outside and wonderfully fluffy inside. You can find excellent, authentic loukoumades at GreCo on Newbury Street, where they are served fresh and can be customized with various toppings beyond the traditional.

faq.question: Is it worth visiting a donut shop outside of Boston city center?
faq.answer: Absolutely! While many great options are in Boston proper, some of the most beloved, classic donut shops, like Twin Donut in Hyde Park or Hole in One in Brighton, offer a more local, traditional experience at very affordable prices. These neighborhood gems provide a true taste of Boston's diverse culinary landscape and are often easily accessible by public transport.

faq.question: Can I buy donuts in bulk for an event or office?
faq.answer: Yes, most donut shops, especially the larger establishments like Union Square Donuts, Blackbird Doughnuts, and Kane's Handcrafted Donuts, accommodate bulk orders. For dozens or larger quantities, it is highly recommended to call ahead or place an order online in advance. This ensures availability, particularly for specific flavors, and allows the shop to prepare your order efficiently.

faq.question: What's the best time to go for the freshest donuts?
faq.answer: For the absolute freshest donuts, aim to visit early in the morning, right when the shops open or within the first hour. Most bakeries fry their donuts fresh daily, and the earliest batches are often still warm. This also guarantees the best selection of flavors before popular items begin to sell out later in the day.

faq.question: Are there vegan donut options in Boston?
faq.answer: While not as widely available as gluten-free options, a few places occasionally offer vegan donuts. Union Square Donuts sometimes has a vegan special or two, and smaller, independent bakeries might feature them. It's best to check their websites or social media for current offerings or call ahead, as availability can vary.

faq.question: What makes Boston Cream donuts so popular in Boston?
faq.answer: The Boston Cream donut is directly inspired by the Boston Cream Pie, which was invented at Boston's Parker House Hotel. It features a yeast donut filled with a rich vanilla custard (cream) and topped with a shiny chocolate glaze. Its local heritage makes it an iconic, must-try treat when visiting the city, representing a classic Boston flavor profile.
